requiredBehaviors.behavior: prefer the machine-readable sequence listing over manual extraction from narrative PDF text
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The sequence-listing workflow says origin machine-readable listings are preferred and explicitly covers ST.26 XML.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: normalize type length sequence provenance and patent-internal identifiers
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The required sequence record includes type, length, normalized sequence, source, listing standard, patent-internal identifier and provenance.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: use a stable sequence checksum to identify identical sequences across IDs or members
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow explicitly requires a stable sequence checksum to recognize identical sequences across SEQ IDs or family members.
The sequence record explicitly retains references to Claims/Examples/Figures and related biological roles.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: collapse sequence identifiers without retaining provenance
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The workflow requires preservation of source, patent-internal identifiers and related sequences, preventing provenance-free collapsing.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: assume every sequence in the listing is claim-limiting
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The claim atomization and sequence workflow distinguish claim references from disclosed listing content rather than treating every listed sequence as claim-limiting.
